source_expectation: 00216a–f includes breast and colorectal contexts. Reference dose: 1250 mg/m² BID, days 1–14, q21d. Adjuvant colon/TNBC: eight cycles. Advanced disease: until progression or intolerance. A 1000 mg/m² start may be considered for selected patients.
implementation: Existing stable indications and treatment phases are preserved. Exact context must be selected; no breast/CRC evidence transplant.
unresolved: Indications d, e and f carry the source off-label consent/policy footnote. No new indication is inferred from a duration paragraph.

source_expectation: ECOG 0–2; baseline FBC, renal and liver profile; DPD testing unless previously tested. FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle. Disease monitoring follows the consultant plan.
implementation: ECOG review retained; monitoring is carried into patient/KB/support work. No universal imaging or tumour-marker interval is invented.

source_expectation: Complete DPD deficiency excludes treatment. Partial deficiency needs an individualised reduced start and careful monitoring. Renal impairment can confound uracil phenotyping. Severe prior reaction, hypersensitivity, pregnancy/lactation and recent brivudine are exclusions.
implementation: Existing exclusion rules retained. Guidance adds the uracil caveat and genotype consideration, distinguishing initial partial-DPD titration from toxicity-dose re-escalation.
unresolved: There is no universal partial-DPD percentage in this regimen; DPD status is not calculated from renal function.

source_location: NCCP p3 prose; EMA p5 section4.2
source_expectation: NCCP advises caution for ANC <1.5 or platelets <100; EMA says these patients should not be treated.
implementation: Consultant review explicitly identifies both sources and states no automatic initiation. Boundary and missing-input cases retained.
unresolved: This wording difference remains for clinical/pharmacy resolution. The subsequent-dose platelet threshold of 75 is not baseline clearance.

source_expectation: Interrupt for ANC <1 or platelets <75. ANC 1–<1.5 differs from the next-dose recovery threshold.
implementation: Distinct within-cycle hold/review rules retained. No recurrence percentage is automatically applied within a cycle.

source_expectation: ANC 1–1.49 or platelets 50–74.9: 100/75/50/stop for events 1–4. ANC 0.5–0.99 or platelets 25–49.9: 75/50/stop/stop. ANC <0.5 or platelets <25: stop, with a first-event consultant exception to delay then 50%.
implementation: Both current recovery counts and both episode nadirs are required for numerical restart. A historical permanent-stop threshold remains valid before complete recovery.
unresolved: Printed decimal bands are treated as continuous intervals below the upper threshold, not silently rounded. The severe first-event exception never produces an automatic 50% restart.

source_expectation: After a toxicity reduction, the dose must not be increased. Omitted toxicity doses are not replaced.
implementation: Previous prescribed percentage gates all 75/50% restart outputs. Unknown or lower history produces review. The 100% table row remains a review. Percentages use the documented original start and are not compounded.
unresolved: Initial partial-DPD titration is a distinct consultant-managed exception.

source_location: NCCP p3 Table2; EMA p6 section4.2
source_expectation: NCCP: CrCl 30–50 gives 75% of original dose; 51–80 gives no adjustment; below 30 or dialysis is not recommended. EMA distinguishes 1250 and 1000 mg/m² starts and contraindicates severe renal impairment.
implementation: A documented 1250 start with a genuine baseline or safe prior-dose context gives 75%. Reduced, other or unknown starts/history require source reconciliation. Severe impairment and dialysis actions are retained with clearer attribution.
unresolved: NCCP/EMA reduced-start disagreement and 50–51 mL/min decimal gap remain unresolved numerically. No silent rounding or dose escalation.

source_location: NCCP p3 Table2,p6 Table6; EMA pp7–8
source_expectation: NCCP specifies no routine hepatic adjustment. Treatment-related bilirubin >3 or ALT/AST >2.5 requires a hold. EMA lists severe hepatic impairment as a contraindication.
implementation: Baseline or assessed non-treatment-related elevations prompt review; current or uncertain-attribution elevations retain hold and clarification. Severe hepatic exclusion is separate.
unresolved: Source recovery wording uses OR. The tool does not clear one affected test while another remains abnormal and never issues restart clearance from an isolated normal result.

source_expectation: Grade 2 events 1/2/3/4: 100/75/50/stop. Grade 3 events 1/2/3: 75/50/stop. Grade 4: stop, with a first-event consultant exception.
implementation: Current hold, documented peak/recurrence/recovery and previous-dose checks. A grade 3 episode remains controlling after partial improvement to grade 2; terminal recurrence stops before full recovery.
unresolved: Nocturnal stools appear in both low-grade and grade 2 NCCP rows. UI acknowledges the overlap; EMA patient stop-and-contact advice is preserved.

source_expectation: Grade 2/3 requires interruption until grade ≤1. Grade 3 requires a subsequent reduction, with no percentage specified.
implementation: Input descriptions now use NCCP table 5; hold and unquantified consultant-review pathways retained.
unresolved: A 75% reduction is not imported from general table 3, which applies to toxicities not separately specified.

source_location: NCCP p4 Table3 and p5 Tables4–5
source_expectation: Table 3 cites CTCAE v4. Table 4 contains legacy bands; table 5 is regimen-specific.
implementation: Diarrhoea/HFS attributes identify their actual source table. Generic CTCAE v5 mucositis/other-toxicity UI aids are explicitly distinguished from source v4.
unresolved: Generic displayed aids are not represented as regimen-specific source definitions; the clinician confirms the grade.

source_expectation: Grade 2 or higher dehydration requires immediate interruption. Restart only after rehydration and correction/control of the cause.
implementation: Active dehydration or an uncontrolled cause holds treatment. Even recovered/controlled status requires kidney, causative-toxicity, history and restart-plan review.

source_expectation: Significant cardiac history requires caution. Chest pain prompts stop/contact. Severe skin reactions such as SJS/TEN require permanent discontinuation.
implementation: New optional cardiac-history review, current-chest-pain hold/urgent assessment and severe-skin stop. No automatic cardiac rechallenge.

source_expectation: Brivudine interval: at least four weeks. Coumarin: close INR/PT monitoring. Phenytoin: plasma-level monitoring.
implementation: Brivudine exclusion now cites the freshly retrieved EMA source. Optional monitoring prompts do not calculate interacting-drug doses.

source_expectation: Other clinical cautions, comorbidities and symptoms still require clinical review.
implementation: All inputs remain optional. Blank/null values are unassessed. A generic toxicity field does not replace clinical assessment or authorise prescribing.
unresolved: This bounded protocol audit does not establish independent clinical approval, global consistency, device installation/printing, camera QR scanning or production deployment.
